evidence.detail: The class extends the recovered plugin base, injects Client/config/overlay/menu services, provides the already-authoritative R4 NpcIndicatorsConfig, and owns plugin start/stop lifecycle methods.
Surviving literals are 'Tag', 'Un-tag', 'Tag-All' and 'Un-tag-All'; menu-hover and custom-menu paths apply those actions to NPC indicator state.
The plugin subscribes to ConfigChanged, GameStateChanged, NpcSpawned and MenuHover and manages HighlightedNpc/MemorizedNpc state together with R189 NpcIndicatorsOverlay.
Surviving style literals include 'hull', 'tile', 'truetile', 'swtile', 'swtruetile' and 'outline', matching the authoritative R4 NpcIndicatorsConfig and R189 overlay family.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 NPC Indicators plugin identity from literal config/menu/render vocabulary and complete plugin/overlay family joins. The config class is already authoritative in R4 and is intentionally not re-proposed here.
